evidence.snippet: We introduce \textsc{TSM-Bench}, a multilingual, multi-generator, and \textit{multi-task} benchmark for evaluating MGT detectors on common, real-world Wikipedia editing tasks.

claire_radar.motivation: Automatically detecting machine-generated text (MGT) is critical to maintaining the knowledge integrity of user-generated content (UGC) platforms such as Wikipedia.
